analogy.rationale: PDE inhibitors block cAMP/cGMP breakdown, mimicking agents that raise these cyclic nucleotides (adenylyl/guanylate cyclase activators, adenosine or prostanoid receptor agonists) and opposing nitric oxide synthase inhibition. Because the measured cell lines express few of the targeted PDEs and 6-24 h mRNA changes are modest, the expected response is weak.
